en.headline: Court of Appeal grants 11 defendants certificate to seek CFA leave in 35+ case
en.dek: The Court of Appeal certified five points of law of great and general importance arising from the national-security convictions linked to the 2020 democratic primary.
body: The Court of Appeal on Monday granted 11 defendants in the 35+ national-security case a certificate allowing them to seek leave to appeal to the Court of Final Appeal.

The 11, including former legislators and activists, had their conviction and sentence appeals dismissed by the Court of Appeal in February. They applied for a certificate that points of law of great and general importance arise. The court certified five issues, including the scope of “other unlawful means” under Article 22 of the National Security Law and whether an agreement to trigger the Basic Law budget-veto mechanism carried a subversive intent.

The defendants had already lodged applications for leave directly with the Court of Final Appeal. The certificate means the Court of Final Appeal will now consider whether to grant leave to appeal on the certified points.

zh.headline: 35+案11名被告獲批終院上訴證明書
zh.dek: 上訴庭裁定五項涉及國安法及基本法預算案機制的法律議題屬廣泛及重要，批出證明書。
body: 上訴庭周一就35+顛覆國家政權案，批出證明書予11名被告，容許他們向終審法院申請上訴許可。
11名被告包括前立法會議員及社運人士，他們早前就定罪及判刑向上訴庭上訴被駁回後，申請證明書。上訴庭就五項議題批出證明書，包括國安法第22條「其他非法手段」的範圍，以及協議觸發基本法否決預算案機制是否含有顛覆意圖等。
該批被告早前已直接向終審法院申請上訴許可。有證明書後，終審法院將考慮是否就該等法律議題批出上訴許可。
